events.title: EFG London Jazz Festival, London
events.note: Ten days of jazz across more than 70 London venues, from the Barbican and Royal Festival Hall to small clubs. The opening weekend includes Emma-Jean Thackray's Dear Miles, a Coltrane centenary concert and Goldie's Dare to Dream.
